BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to galley service on Washington state ferries;adding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall seek to promptly reestablish galley foodservice on vessels. In reestablishing galley service, the departmentshall follow these principles: (1) First, make every effort to facilitate the completion ofcurrent negotiations for the provision of galley service for the 2005summer season. (2) At a minimum, fully recover the costs of providing galleyservice. (3) Consider state operation of galley service if it will result inearliest commencement of the service.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 HB 2205state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
